prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for sign_in, reorder changes is still thin with only one test conducted.
Evidence for home, wait_info changes is still thin with only one test conducted.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to measured and noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- home, wait_info: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive pet preview step before adoption: Insert an interactive pet desktop preview screen right after selection to let users see how their pet behaves on the desktop before finalizing adoption. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a mean duration of 1017s, and support emails noted custom pet visually failing or confusing users.)
1: [finish, redesign] Split layout guide for desktop controls on finish screen: Redesign the home intro screen into a split layout that highlights desktop placement, tray shortcuts, and pet interaction controls. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and support received multiple complaints from users confused about how to hide, control, or talk to their pet.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Defer sign-in to end of onboarding: Move sign-in screen to occur right before the home intro screen, letting users adopt and personalize their pet before creating an account. (why: Sign-in screen has a long mean duration (567s) early on, and users reported post-login account and pet linking issues.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Cloud backup messaging on sign-in screen: Update headline and body on the sign-in screen to clarify that signing in backs up pet traits to cloud sync so pets are never lost on re-login. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after users signed back in.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop status hint on waiting screen: Add an explicit rendering status hint on the waiting screen explaining that background assets are being built for the desktop overlay. (why: Home wait time has a high mean (2336s), and 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app failing to start.)
5: [finish, hint] Tray control hint on final screen: Add a visual hint box to the home intro screen explaining how to access pet settings via the system tray icon. (why: Users wrote support mails expressing confusion on how to hide, control, or interact with their pet after setup.)
6: [adoption, layout] Two-column customization layout for pet picking: Change pick_friend screen layout to two_column to display pet trait choices on the left and live pet preview on the right. (why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and support mails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected results.)
7: [home, notification] Completion notification alert on waiting screen: Enable desktop notification callout on the waiting screen to alert users when asset generation finishes. (why: Median wait time is 201s (mean 2336s); notifying users when ready prevents dropping off while waiting in background.)

scores.note: Targets largest funnel drop-off with strong evidence, but requires a new screen.
Redesign addresses major finish drop-off and user confusion, but higher build cost.
Reordering sign-in builds on past +3.4% test, though evidence remains thin.
Cheap copy fix addressing cloud backup confusion reported in support emails.
Easy config hint for long wait times, but past wait_info test saw modest +1.6% lift.
Low cost hint addressing high drop-off and user control confusion on finish step.
Improves live preview layout on worst conversion step without adding new screens.
Notification alerts prevent drop-off during long 200s+ background wait times.
